title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')… (CVE-2026-133438)
description: CVE-2026-133438 is a high-severity injection vulnerability in MediaWiki version 1.47. It involves improper neutralization of special elements in output used by downstream components, affecting specific program files. This flaw could allow an attacker with low privileges to cause significant impact without user interaction.
